newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil stevedores to decide on strikes after talks.
newsitem.headline: Brazil stevedores to decide on strikes after talks.

text.p: Stevedores at the key Brazilian port of Santos will decide whether to stage further strikes after meeting representatives from steel firm Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) on Monday, a union official said.

The stevedores effectively stopped loading and unloading operations at the port for three days from April 2 in protest at a ruling allowing Cosipa workers to conduct stevedore operations at Cosipa's private terminal.

A nationwide stoppage called by the National Stevedores Federation received 85 percent support. All members returned to work as agreed at 0700 local/1000 GMT on April 5 and operations at Santos were normal except at the Cosipa terminal which was still paralysed, the union official said.
After the return to work, union leaders said that further stoppages were likely.
"Everything depends on the meeting with Cosipa on Monday," the union official said.
The meeting is to begin at 0800 local/1100 GMT.
